title: Create a new keychain
summary: Create a new keychain file with a specified password. This is useful for isolating credentials for specific applications or projects.

steps.explain: Create a new keychain file at the specified path, protected by the given password.

placeholders.name: PASSWORD
placeholders.description: The password to protect the new keychain.

placeholders.name: KEYCHAIN_PATH
placeholders.description: The full path where the new keychain file should be created.
